title: Public Streamable HTTP MCP edge
objective: Implement the relay-side public Streamable HTTP MCP edge and the relay side of the SG-000055 device channel in a separate open-source relay package: a standards-compliant `/mcp` endpoint with protected-resource metadata and bearer challenges, SG-000054 access token verification and default-deny scope enforcement on every request, exact mapping of each authenticated MCP session onto one paired device route through frozen SG-000052 frames, bounded requests, responses, streams, and sessions, backpressure, correct session semantics, and fail-closed offline behavior, with no provider-specific hidden authority and no generic executor.

include: separate open-source relay workspace package that reuses the frozen SG-000052, SG-000053, SG-000054, and SG-000055 vocabulary instead of redefining it

public `/mcp` Streamable HTTP endpoint (JSON-RPC over POST, session management with `Mcp-Session-Id`, explicit 405 for unsupported methods) and RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata with RFC 6750 bearer challenges
SG-000054 access token verification, issuer, audience, expiry, revocation, and device-epoch checks on every request and the default-deny scope to tool ceiling before any frame is created
authenticated remote context derived only from the verified token and the stored paired route, never from MCP payload or tool arguments
relay side of the device channel: challenge, channel session, long-poll, and push endpoints with device-key verification, route binding, outbound frame validation, and correlation to pending requests

bounded request and response bodies, bounded sessions per principal and in total, bounded pending requests, timeouts, backpressure, Origin validation, and typed fail-closed behavior when the device is offline
class-only logging with no token, payload, argument, or result material
exclude: the authorization server endpoints, pairing enrollment, durable relay storage, quotas configuration, self-host packaging, and reference deployment (SG-000057)
SOCKS, CONNECT, arbitrary TCP, generic HTTP proxying, arbitrary WebSocket forwarding, raw shell tunnels, or any generic executor
any provider-specific authority, hidden tool, or tool outside the authoritative catalog
any change to the local tool registry, schemas, capabilities, approvals, or the cotrad remote-session lease
any provider submission or public availability claim

authority_delta.filesystem: None on the device. The relay process holds only its own in-memory state.
authority_delta.network: The relay listens for the public `/mcp` edge and device channel endpoints only; it forwards nothing anywhere except frozen MCP frames to the one paired device route.
authority_delta.secrets: Access tokens and channel tokens are verified transiently and never logged.
authority_delta.approval: None. The relay cannot create, widen, renew, or extend a remote-session lease or satisfy any approval.

invariants: every remote MCP request is authenticated and scope-checked at the edge and re-checked on the device and by cotrad
the relay derives remote context only from the verified token and the stored paired route
an offline device fails closed with a typed error and nothing is durably queued
the edge exposes exactly the authoritative tool catalog through the device and no other operation
the SG-000052 through SG-000055 vocabulary stays frozen

acceptance.claim: A standards-compliant Streamable HTTP `/mcp` edge with protected-resource metadata and bearer challenges reaches one paired device through the outbound-only channel and returns the authoritative catalog and typed results.
Every request is token-verified and scope-checked before framing; missing, expired, revoked, wrong-audience, wrong-scope, and unknown-tool requests fail closed without reaching the device.

Requests, responses, sessions, pending work, and streams are bounded with backpressure; an offline device, a channel without valid device proof, malformed or cross-route device frames, and oversized payloads fail closed.
Exact-head CI including release qualification and supply-chain audit, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual review of excluded files, and zero unresolved review threads all pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000057: The open-source relay with authorization server, pairing enrollment, durable state, quotas, self-host mode, and zero-cost reference deployment may proceed only after SG-000056 closes with the public edge qualified.

done_when: The public Streamable HTTP MCP edge is canonical with per-request authentication, default-deny scopes, exact device mapping, bounded resources, and fail-closed offline behavior.

canonical_evidence.authority_boundary: Separate open-source relay package with the public Streamable HTTP /mcp edge, protected-resource metadata, and the relay side of the device channel, forwarding frozen MCP frames only to one paired device route after per-request token and scope verification. No outbound requests from the relay, no proxy, executor, MCP tool, schema, capability, approval, or lease authority; no change to the device tool registry.
